<!-- Generated by cmd/vocabgen from internal/vocab/terms.yaml. Do not edit by hand; run make gen. -->

Every word the console, the API and these docs use for a thing you manage means one thing, defined
here. **API** is the collection the thing lives under; **Permission** is the noun its permissions
carry (`component:read`); **Formerly** is a word it replaced, which no longer appears.

## Operator terms

| Term | Meaning | API | Permission | Formerly |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **alarm** | A raised problem on a component, with a severity, from the moment it raises until it clears. | `/alarms` | `alarm` |  |
| **command** | One instruction sent to a component, typed by a command type, and its outcome. |  | `command` |  |
| **component** | One managed device or service, an instance of a product, placed at a location and usually a member of a system. | `/components` | `component` |  |
| **degraded** | The health of a system that still works but has lost something it should have. |  |  |  |
| **detail view** | An entity's own page, a system with its location as context, or a location or component on its own. |  |  | workspace |
| **endpoint** | A connection to a component over one transport, the API Omniglass reaches it through. | `/endpoints` | `endpoint` | interface |
| **event** | One point-in-time occurrence on a component, typed by an event type. |  |  |  |
| **file** | Uploaded content kept with the fleet, such as a firmware image, a config dump or a runbook. | `/files` | `file` |  |
| **fleet** | Everything an install manages, the locations, the systems in them and the components that make them up. |  |  | estate, inventory |
| **healthy** | The health of a system whose components are all present and well. |  |  |  |
| **incomplete** | The health of a system still missing a component its standard requires, shown as Commissioning. |  |  |  |
| **label** | The optional friendly string a person reads in place of a name. |  |  | display name, label template |
| **location** | A place the fleet occupies, from a campus down to a room, nested under the location it sits in. | `/locations` | `location` |  |
| **notification** | One message about an alarm sent on one channel, such as a webhook, an email or the inbox. | `/notifications` | `notification` |  |
| **outage** | The health of a system that cannot do its job. |  |  |  |
| **secret** | An encrypted credential set at one level of the fleet and inherited below it. | `/secrets` | `secret` |  |
| **system** | The unit Omniglass monitors, a set of components in one location that works as one, with one health of its own. | `/systems` | `system` |  |
| **tag** | An operator's key and value on a location, system or component, its key governed install-wide. | `/tags` | `tag` |  |
| **template** | An example you clone to start a standard, a component, a system or a set of locations, then own what you get. | `/templates` | `template` |  |
| **variable** | A named value set at one level of the fleet and inherited below it, written into text as $var. | `/variables` | `variable` |  |

## Admin terms

| Term | Meaning | API | Permission | Formerly |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **action rule** | A rule that decides when a notification about an alarm is sent, and to which targets. | `/action-rules` | `rule` |  |
| **audit event** | One recorded privileged action or sign-in, with who did it, when and to what. | `/audit-log` | `audit` |  |
| **calc rule** | A rule that derives a new value from other signals on each owner it applies to. | `/calc-rules` | `rule` |  |
| **catalog** | The rows the fleet is typed by, the types, products, vendors and drivers an install ships and an admin extends. |  |  | registry |
| **command type** | Something a component can be told to do in the catalog, with its target and how long it takes to settle. | `/command-types` | `command_type` |  |
| **component type** | The device class a product belongs to, such as display, projector or microphone. | `/component-types` | `component_type` |  |
| **driver** | The declared recipe that collects from a product, what to fetch, how to read it and what it can set. | `/drivers` | `driver` |  |
| **event rule** | A rule that watches signals and fires when its criteria hold, raising an alarm if it carries a severity. | `/event-rules` | `rule` |  |
| **event type** | A kind of discrete occurrence in the catalog, what an event is typed by. | `/event-types` | `event_type` |  |
| **location type** | What kind of location a location is, and which kinds it may sit under. | `/location-types` | `location_type` |  |
| **metric type** | A numeric signal in the catalog, the series a sample measures, with its unit and precision. | `/metric-types` | `metric_type` |  |
| **notification target** | Where a notification goes, a webhook, a mailbox, a user group or a person. | `/notification-targets` | `notification_target` |  |
| **notification type** | What a notification about an alarm says, as a subject and a text. | `/notification-types` | `notification_type` |  |
| **outpost** | A collection process placed near the fleet that runs tasks and commands over endpoints and reports back. | `/outposts` | `outpost` | node |
| **product** | A concrete model a vendor sells, with the driver that collects from it and the component type it is classified under. | `/products` | `product` |  |
| **property type** | A categorical signal in the catalog, a value a component reports or is declared to have. | `/property-types` | `property_type` |  |
| **role** | A named bundle of permissions granted to users, which may inherit another role's. | `/roles` | `role` |  |
| **secret type** | A shape a secret can take, such as a password or an API key, built into Omniglass. | `/secret-types` | `secret` |  |
| **setting** | A platform or user preference, resolved from the user up to the platform default. | `/settings` | `settings` |  |
| **severity level** | How bad an alarm is, ranked, with its color and whether it takes its component out. | `/severity-levels` | `severity_level` |  |
| **standard** | The contract a system is built to, declaring the slots it fills and the properties every conforming system exposes. | `/standards` | `standard` | blueprint |
| **system slot** | A position in a system a component fills, such as a main display or a table microphone, with how many it wants and what losing it means. |  |  | system role |
| **system type** | What kind of space a system is, such as a boardroom, a classroom or a video wall. | `/system-types` | `system_type` |  |
| **task** | An outpost's unit of collection, a poll it runs or a listener it holds on one endpoint. | `/tasks` | `task` |  |
| **transport** | The wire an endpoint speaks over, such as ssh, https or snmp, built into Omniglass. | `/transports` | `endpoint` |  |
| **unclaimed source** | A device an outpost heard from that no endpoint claims yet, waiting to be adopted or ignored. | `/unclaimed-sources` | `outpost` |  |
| **user** | Who a role is granted to, a person who signs in or a machine user that holds tokens. | `/principals` | `principal` | principal, service account, human |
| **user group** | A set of users granted roles together, each member inheriting the group's grants. | `/principal-groups` | `principal_group` | principal group |
| **vendor** | An organization behind products, a manufacturer, an integrator or a developer. | `/vendors` | `vendor` |  |
